questions: Door frames to the UCON survey. Our build-up: backing frame {{bu['frame_t']}} + clip gap {{bu['clip_gap']}} (Fastmount VL-03H, recess) + panel {{bu['panel_t']}} = panel face {{bu['face']}} mm from the wall (your drawing: 40 + 22). The panels are rebated at the back 10 over the frame, as on all our AP walls (not your BATTENTE 38 x 18), so the frame front sits 12 behind the panel face (as the other AP doors, frame front {{-dr('D02')['jamb_y'][0]}} from the wall face): D02 (Safe) jamb {{dr('D02')['jamb']}} on a {{dr('D02')['wall_t']}} wall, D03 (AV) jamb {{dr('D03')['jamb']}} on a {{dr('D03')['wall_t']}} wall (your drawing: 210 on 170, front 4 behind a 62 face). Please confirm you can make these depths.

Openings per UCON survey: D02 {{ow('D02')}} x {{oh('D02')}}, D03 {{ow('D03')}} x {{oh('D03')}} (your drawing: 1222 / 1000 x 2540). Your gaps (sides {{dr('D02')['gap_side']}}, head {{dr('D02')['gap_head']}}) give frames {{ow('D02') - 2 * dr('D02')['gap_side']}} / {{ow('D03') - 2 * dr('D03')['gap_side']}} x {{oh('D02') - dr('D02')['gap_head']}} and leaves {{op('D02')['clad'][1] - op('D02')['clad'][0]}} / {{op('D03')['clad'][1] - op('D03')['clad'][0]}} x {{op('D02')['clad'][3] - op('D02')['clad'][2]}}, {{op('D02')['clad'][2]}} above the floor (your drawing: 1137 / 915 x 2492). Please confirm.
Safe door (D02): your production drawings TELAIO / PORTA / PANNELLI marked 'DX A TIRARE' show 990 / 915 / 920 - the AV door sizes. Please issue the drawings of the Safe door to the sizes in Q2.

Handing: both doors open into the Garage (pull side = Garage). Your drawing: D02 hinges on the right, D03 on the left, as seen from the Garage. Daniel's list of 01/12/2026 says Safe 'Left-Handed', AV 'Right-Handed'. Please confirm both describe the same doors.

Leaf: {{dr('D02')['leaf_t']}} thick (face {{dr('D02')['leaf_t'] - dr('D02')['leaf_step']['t']}} + back step {{dr('D02')['leaf_step']['t']}} x {{dr('D02')['leaf_step']['inset']}}), veneered, no applied panel, face flush with the wall panels, 10 joint to the panels all round - as your PORTA section. Integrated handle on the room side; on the Garage side push-to-open (not guaranteed by TM). Please confirm the leaf build-up, finish and the push-to-open hardware.
The Safe opening runs to the ceiling today; it will be lowered to {{oh('D02')}} (the AV head) by others before the frame is set. Frame and panels are drawn to {{oh('D02')}}.

Panels to the UCON survey: wall {{@s['walls'][0]['L']}} x {{@s['walls'][0]['ceil'][0][2]}} (your drawing: 8016 x 2844), leaves centred in our openings, joints 10 - also around the door leaves, the horizontal joint along the leaf top {{op('D02')['clad'][3]}} - free spans split equally. Sizes per A-701 replace your cut list 252260 rev 3 (P01-P14 = your numbers 1-14). Panels in front of the door frames: rear 10 rebate as on our other AP walls, instead of your BATTENTE 38 x 18. Please confirm.

Panels hang on Fastmount VL-03H clips, recess mount, gap {{bu['clip_gap']}}. Please make the clip recesses in the panel backs at the factory per the D-sheets (D{{@s['clips']['hole_d']}} x {{@s['clips']['panel_depth']}} deep). Please confirm which clip half goes into the panel (we assume male).

All drilling coordinates are given from the panel BACK: X from the left edge as seen from the back, Z from the bottom edge. A control column gives X from the face. Please confirm before drilling - mirrored drilling is the main risk.
sheets.questions_note: Red number = open question, marked with the same red bubble on the sheet it belongs to. Answers to be written in the ANSWER column and returned; the drawings are reissued after the answers.

G-001: Survey by UCON. All dimensions in mm, Z from the floor. Dimensions per UCON survey govern; from the TM drawings (order 252260, rev 3) only the door profile is used.

Wall panels MDF {{bu['panel_t']}}, finish per TM; joints 10, also to the door leaves; 10 to the floor, ceiling and wall corners, no baseboard. Panel face {{bu['face']}} from the wall = backing frame {{bu['frame_t']}} + clip gap {{bu['clip_gap']}} + panel {{bu['panel_t']}}. Numbers P01..P14 as TM cut list 252260 (Q7).

Backing frames S01..S{{format('%02d', @s['frames'].values.sum { |f| f['frames'].size })}}: plywood 3/4", made, drilled and fixed by UCON (A-20x, A-702, A-703), {{@s['levels']['floor_gap']}} above the floor; a frame member behind every panel joint - no raw wall in a joint. Clips Fastmount VL-03H, recess mount, {{@s['holes'].size}} pcs: panel recesses by the factory per the D-sheets (BACK VIEW), frame holes by UCON CNC.

Doors D02 (Safe) / D03 (AV): TM pull doors, open into the Garage (toward the panels - the other AP doors open away); veneered 50 leaves flush with the panels, no cladding (Q5); frames to our survey (Q1, Q2). Panels {{rebated}} rebated at the back {{bu['rebate']}} over the frames, as our other AP walls.
Safe opening to be lowered to the AV head by others (Q6).
Red marks are open questions or TBD items. Not for production until G-002 is answered and the set is reissued.
